annotations.title: Net salary: Italy vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Italy (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Italy, in EUR

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

municipal.description: Municipal surtax rate. Milan 0.8%, Rome 0.9%. Set by each comune. (%). Default 0.8.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

region.description: Region: lombardy = Lombardy (Milan); lazio = Lazio (Rome); piedmont = Piedmont (Turin); veneto = Veneto (Venice, Verona); tuscany = Tuscany (Florence); campania = Campania (Naples). Default lombardy.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: compare_with_netherlands
title: Net salary: Italy vs the Netherlands
